==80%==
You walk 10 miles northeast, then turn south and walk a further 20 miles. You then walk in a straight line back to your starting point. What shape have you just made?

You have walked in three straight lines without retracing your steps and end up where you started which makes a triangle.

==1%==
Given that:

0 + 100 = 100<br>1 + 99 = 100<br>2 + 98 = 100

What is the sum of all the whole numbers between zero and 100?

There are 50 pairs that total 100 (0 & 100, 1 & 99, 2 & 98 etc). That makes 5000, but there is also the number 50 in the middle, that is not in a pair but also needs to be counted, giving a total of 5050.
